title: Natural Meal
summary: Eat a real meal your own way for about six minutes.
purpose: Capture meal pauses, conversation and drinking with three video and AirPods timing markers. Actual chewing spans are labelled afterwards.

request.summary: The first take ended early. Use a shorter recording and three timing markers so a completed take can be checked for alignment.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and check that Collect is receiving motion.
Prop the iPhone upright in steady light with your face and jaw visible.
Have your usual meal. Talk, pause or drink whenever you normally would.
Watch for the midpoint and final nod prompts. If you finish eating early, stay seated until the final nod.

camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, with the front camera facing you.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera. Nod down once, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still

activities.instruction: Eat your meal as you normally would
activities.detail: Chew, pause, talk or drink whenever you like.
activities.expected_behavior: Natural meal with any mix of chewing, speech, drinking and rest

activities.instruction: Pause chewing. Nod down once, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still

activities.instruction: Keep eating naturally, or relax if you are done
activities.expected_behavior: Natural eating, finishing, or resting after the meal

activities.instruction: Finish with one downward nod, then slowly return upright.
activities.expected_behavior: One sharp downward nod with a slow return; mouth still
